thread:
anya.t: Quick follow-up from the 2026-03-18 postmortem. We still have outstanding action items to reduce paging noise and tighten ownership. Can we list owners + acceptance criteria + dates so the postmortem can be marked resolved?

mike.h: I can take the dedupe & fingerprinting changes. Plan: implement fingerprinting that drops per-request ids but keeps service and endpoint tags. Will also add unit tests for the dedupe code. Target: PR by Fri.

ravi.p: I'll own threshold adjustments and a short-term mitigation. My idea: bump non-prod latency alert from 250ms->500ms and add a secondary alert that fires only when error rate increases >5% over 10m. Will validate against last 60 days.

elaine.c: I'll own the paging policy docs and pilot. Suggest pilot on one non-critical service for 7 days, with clear rollback. Will update PD escalation mapping and create a pilot tracking doc.

ops-bot: Created follow-up task: TASK-2026-7894, linked to PMM. Notifications sent.

anya.t: Nice. Can everyone post a one-line acceptance criteria + firm deadline here? We want to close the postmortem actions by next week.

mike.h: Acceptance: staging shows >=65% drop in PD pages for rule WorkerError within 72h of change. Deadline: 2026-03-29.

ravi.p: Acceptance: adjusted thresholds reduce false positive alerts to <7% on historical eval; no missed high-impact incidents in a 30-day backtest. Deadline: 2026-03-28.

elaine.c: Acceptance: policy doc updated, PD mappings changed, pilot runs for 7 days with named service owner and rollback procedure. Deadline: 2026-03-27.

anya.t: For implementation notes: mike, please avoid aggressive label dropping; keep tenant_id and region. ravi, include the backtest queries in the PR. elaine, include the pilot checklist and success criteria in the doc.

mike.h: Example dedupe pattern I'll try:
```yaml
- alert: WorkerErrorBurst
  expr: increase(worker_errors_total{job="worker"}[5m]) > 100
  labels:
    dedupe_fingerprint: "{{ job }}:{{ error_code }}:{{ region }}"
```
That should group by error type and region.

ravi.p: Backtest note: some spikes are correlated with downstream rate limits; I'll add an exclude filter for 503s caused by third_party_api where applicable.

elaine.c: Pilot owner suggestion: @sarah.ops for the first week. I'll ping her and document sign-off steps.

anya.t: I'm creating the follow-up issue and adding these acceptance criteria. I'll also ask CS to confirm customer impact window.

ops-bot: Follow-up issue created: PMM-2026-1132.

mike.h: I'll open the PR and attach staging logs; will tag for quick review.

ravi.p: Posting histogram graphs and backtest CSV in 2h.

elaine.c: Drafted the pilot doc and linked the rollback playbook. Tagging @sarah.ops now.

anya.t: Great progress. Let's meet 10m Mon to confirm status. If blockers pop up, escalate to me directly. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
